observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission gear box lying on a concrete floor.
The unit has a large circular opening in the center, likely the input shaft or bell housing.
There are various hoses, connectors, and metal components attached to the unit.
The surface is dirty and shows signs of use and exposure to the elements.
A watermark 'BLESSED CHILD' is visible on the image.
No visible branding or model markings are readable on the gear box itself.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 automatic transmission gear box
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model markings on the gear box in photo 0. The seller's text alone cannot confirm the make or model.
No pins or connectors are visible in photo 0 to confirm a 9-pin connector. This claim cannot be verified from the photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The gear box may not be from a Toyota Corolla 2010 as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission housing or a label showing the make and model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic automatic transmission gear box, not a Toyota Corolla 2010.

risks.risk: The 9-pin connector claim may be false or misleading.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the connector or a label indicating the pin count.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a gear box without a 9-pin connector, which may affect compatibility with the buyer's system.

risks.risk: The gear box may be damaged, worn, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the internal components, or a test run if possible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or in unknown condition.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the transmission housing or label showing the make and model.
Close-up photo of the 9-pin connector or any label indicating the pin count.
Photo or video showing the internal components or a test run if possible.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
